{{Quote|Ah, you scaredy-norg human.|[[Keek]]|<ref name="hll">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>}}
'''Norgs''' were [[Feline/Legends|feline]] animals native to the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]]. Norgs were known for their timidity,<ref name="cswe">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and native [[Brigian]]s commonly referred to cowardly beings as "scaredy-norgs."<ref name="hll" />

==Behind the scenes==
Norgs were first mentioned in ''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]'', a novel written by [[Brian Daley]] and released in [[1980]].<ref name="hll" />
